verdict.rationale: Ledgy supports attaching historical documents to the cap table and segmenting permissions/access controls for team members and financial reporting, which are building blocks for diligence sharing, but the evidence never describes a dedicated permissioned 'data room' feature for sharing with external counsel or investors. missing for 10: explicit external investor/counsel sharing or data-room feature, granular document-level permissioning for outside parties, audit trail of external access.
